scope: R3-G4 sidecar-aware synthetic CPU prefix and causal audit
matrix_artifact_note: The existing 12-run GPU sidecar matrix was not rerun; this report validates the current implementation with deterministic CPU probes after the frame-zero control convention fix.

constant_velocity_not_admission_gate.policy: diagnostic_per_case; never a physical-scene admission gate

findings.detail: Frame-zero prescribed-control velocity is explicitly zero because no past sample exists; frame one onward uses only current-minus-previous transforms.

Changing/appending future reference, control, and sidecar-summary frames leaves shared-prefix features and deterministic predictions unchanged; elapsed time is absolute elapsed time divided by a case scale, not file endpoint normalization.
Rollout reports hard displacement-clip numerator, denominator, fraction, and trigger flag separately from smooth output-cap saturation counts/rate.
Constant-velocity comparisons remain per-case diagnostics and do not gate physical-scene admission.
